description: This is a PHP unit test class for the I18NError entity, testing creation, duplication constraints, null handling, and exception cases for the entity within the OrangeHRM internationalization plugin.

classes.name: I18NErrorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the I18NError entity's behavior and constraints within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific database tables related to I18NError.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntity
methods.description: Tests creation and persistence of a valid I18NError entity and verifies retrieved data.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithDuplicateName
methods.description: Tests that attempting to persist a duplicate I18NError entity with the same name triggers a UniqueConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullName
methods.description: Tests that persisting an I18NError entity without a name triggers an EntityMissingAssignedId exception.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullDescription
methods.description: Tests that persisting an I18NError entity without a message triggers a NotNullConstraintViolationException.
